title: The Host's Share of an Out-of-Network Valuation Fee
content:
Where a vehicle protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan has not been seen in the partner network, the host carries a share of the fee the marketplace pays to have the loss valued outside it.

- Where no workshop visit on the vehicle in the partner network stands in the month before and no passed inspection stands on it in the twelve months before, the host carries the plan's out-of-network valuation share of that fee.
- Where no workshop visit in the partner network stands in that month and a passed inspection stands in the twelve months before, the host carries half of that share.
- Where a workshop visit in the partner network stands in that month, the host carries none of it.

### The share each plan publishes

| Plan | Out-of-network valuation share, percent |
|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 50 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 40 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 30 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 20 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 10 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 0 |

Half of that share is half of the percentage published for the plan: on the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan, whose published share is 30 percent, half of it is 15 percent. On the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan the published share is 0 percent, so the host carries nothing under any of the three readings.

### Records consulted

The workshop visits carried out in the partner network are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan held on that vehicle, taken over the month before; the passed inspections are those recorded on the vehicle within the twelve months before.
